result.instructions: Tools for Wincher, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my keywords rank in the top 10 right now?"; "How did my keyword rankings change over the last month?"; "Who are my tracked competitors and how do they rank?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Wincher data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wincher_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wincher_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wincher_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. wincher_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wincher_get_account
tools.title: Get account and plan limits
tools.description: The Wincher account behind the token: id, timezone and the plan limits with current usage (websites, users, keywords, keyword lookups, map-tracking credits, history days). Check keyword usage here before adding keywords. GET /account.

tools.name: wincher_get_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Wincher user the token belongs to: id, role, state, project access and profile (name, email, language). GET /user.

tools.name: wincher_list_search_engines
tools.title: List search engines
tools.description: The search engines Wincher can track (id, domain such as google.com, country, languages, default location). GET /search-engines.

tools.name: wincher_search_locations
tools.title: Search tracking locations
tools.description: Search the locations Wincher can track rankings for (code, name, country), most popular first, at most 100. Both are required by the API: an ISO country code and a free-text search (at least 3 characters). GET /locations.

search.description: Free text, at least 3 characters, e.g. 'new york' (required by the Wincher API).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US (required by the Wincher API).

tools.name: wincher_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects (folders that group websites): id, name, website_ids, user_ids, and optionally the ranking summary for a period. GET /projects.

order_by.description: Field to order by; prefix with '-' for descending, e.g. 'keyword' or '-created_at'.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

include_ranking.description: Include ranking data (slower and larger). Default false.

start.description: Start of the period (date or ISO date-time, UTC).

end.description: End of the period (date or ISO date-time, UTC).

tools.name: wincher_add_keywords
tools.title: Add keywords to track
tools.description: WRITE: start tracking up to 50 new keywords on ONE website. EACH keyword uses one keyword slot of the plan's keyword quota (see wincher_get_account), and it is tracked and updated from then on; this tool cannot remove keywords again. Each keyword may name a preferred_url (the landing page expected to rank). Invalid or already-tracked keywords are ignored by Wincher (not created). 'groups' are keyword group NAMES to put every keyword in (may be empty; use names from wincher_list_groups, an unknown name may create a new group). POST /websites/{website_id}/keywords/bulk.

preferred_url.description: Preferred landing page for this keyword.

keywords.description: 1-50 keywords to add (each uses one keyword slot).

groups.description: Keyword group names to assign to all of these keywords (default none).

tools.name: wincher_create_group
tools.title: Create keyword group
tools.description: WRITE: create a keyword group on a website, optionally containing existing keywords (ids from wincher_list_keywords). Uses no keyword quota. POST /websites/{website_id}/groups.

keyword_ids.description: Existing keyword ids to put in the group (default none).

tools.name: wincher_create_annotation
tools.title: Create annotation
tools.description: WRITE: add a user annotation (a note shown on the ranking graphs, e.g. 'Launched new landing page') for a date, optionally tied to specific keywords; without keyword_ids it is a global note for the website. Visible to everyone with access to the website. Uses no keyword quota. POST /websites/{website_id}/annotations.

date.description: The date the note is shown at, yyyy-mm-dd.

keyword_ids.description: Keyword ids this note relates to; omit for a global note.
